title: Archive V02 parent custody and unresolved pre-seal review evidence
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Publishes a focused source-inspection archive at `research/h25-v02-parent-custody-evidence`: five exact final caller/parent/pre-seal source snapshots, preserved conditional AI reviews and finite-control receipts, source/hash mapping, static integrity checker and a concrete contributor task. The archive exposes the remaining authenticated original parent-to-child join and actual Tool stdin mismatch. It also preserves a real review discrepancy: intermediate and final pre-seal receipts name identical child bytes while reporting different imported-decoder outcomes. Correctness qualification of that disputed source remains unresolved.

Original V02 acceptance remains **0/8 omission cases and zero completed original activities**. This contribution claims archival integrity and evidence availability. It introduces no mathematical result, native execution, runtime admission, settled cost or measured performance claim. Historical replay controls were not rerun for publication; private controller, financial/runtime records and consultation content are excluded.

## Task and overlap

Explicit publication/handoff assignment; source scope refined to final caller and pre-seal evidence, omitting near-duplicate ancestor sources and private controller content. Publication base: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Related heads refreshed: #6867 `319ea1c5f4097ef87cc0b037327f26374e93e54d`; #6873 `ae7add49484492b49b0141445fbfd6002858da54`; #6885 `6f9457478d22fa31c1e26b98ca4ee1ed43129ac4`; #6910 `3ff875875cb608907c175a7e319370b7b2f7c005`. These merged predecessors provide retained-read repair, original-parent framing, selected-child custody and separate import-order audit context; merge does not establish V02 integration qualification. Exact reuse dispositions are in PREDECESSORS.json.

The added value is the direct caller's existing inert review, consolidated final source pins, preserved failed findings and a source-specific handoff. See the [verification overview](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321#issuecomment-6713710045) and [existing contributor discussion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166).

## Validation

Executed publication checks:

```sh
python3 -I -S -B research/h25-v02-parent-custody-evidence/check_integrity.py
python3 -I -S -B -O research/h25-v02-parent-custody-evidence/check_integrity.py
```

Both modes pass exact inventory, byte/SHA mapping and AST syntax checks. A separate publication reviewer checked all 51 retained files against the originals and reran both static checker modes. No archived candidate imports, historical replays, original Root/native/guest/producer launches or privileged operations occur. The source map records every exact retained file; the publication commit pins the manifest. Archived sources have inert `.txt` extensions and depend on external pinned predecessors and harnesses. The published scope is self-contained source inspection.

Inherited receipts report parent-owner 24+5 controls per mode, terminal 19 per mode, paired 6+2 per mode and direct-entry 33+7 per mode. The final pre-seal review reports 23 ingress/12 host, transferred 35+22, and independent 10/9/6 controls; those are historical claims with the same-digest conflict prominently retained. Full source bootstrap, genuine decision issuance, original live profile, resource census, protected origin, terminal ownership, external cost reconciliation and eight original omissions remain open.

## Credit

Predecessor authors retain credit through #6867, #6873, #6885 and #6910, exact source headers and the repository's Apache-2.0 license. Source preparation, reviews and this export used OpenAI AI assistance. Separate AI reviews are not human or proof-kernel acceptance.

## Open next questions

Please take the focused task in [CONTRIBUTOR-TASK.md](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/563ac6bf2431aa3b90c1a6d321b1a9d34387eb8f/research/h25-v02-parent-custody-evidence/CONTRIBUTOR-TASK.md): reconcile the imported-decoder receipts against identical child SHA `7001e2ba395ebb7e943816301be7830e6a9bb699acc182e2bbeb786148459048`, then specify the source-owned original parent/prebirth-to-protected-origin join beginning at the archived `RootProxy._run`, `run_root` and `_receive_v02_preseal`. The decisive result must justify authentic issuer and source ownership, complete P/E association, pipe lifecycle/descriptor stability and exact failure/resource/cost behavior. The actual non-PTY Tool route remains incompatible; a benign narrow preloaded-FIFO result is only a transport point. Report unavailable assumptions explicitly and preserve 0/8 until genuine original omissions pass.
